solar-site-9.desc: The Blue Barn @ Camp Cedar Creek sits on a hill above the creekside campground providing beautiful views of the forest, creek, ponds, and meadows below. There are 9 open parking spots situated around the barn for vehicle dwellers to stay and utilize the shared amenities inside the structure, including 2 bathrooms w/ showers, a large communal kitchen, a quiet co-working space with fast wifi, a rec area with gym mats and equipment, ping pong and darts, and laundry. SITE 9 (formerly Site 6) is situated next to Site 8 in the main parking lot, all the way to the left and furthest from the barn entrance.

solar-site-8.desc: The Blue Barn @ Camp Cedar Creek sits on a hill above the creekside campground providing beautiful views of the forest, creek, ponds, and meadows below. There are 9 open parking spots situated around the barn for vehicle dwellers to stay and utilize the shared amenities inside the structure, including 2 bathrooms w/ showers, a large communal kitchen, a quiet co-working space with fast wifi, a rec area with gym mats and equipment, ping pong and darts, and laundry. SITE NO. 8 is situated between Sites 7 and 9 on the south side of the main parking lot. This site gets sunshine all day long and is great for vehicles with solar panels.

power-site-6.desc: The Blue Barn @ Camp Cedar Creek sits on a hill above the creekside campground providing beautiful views of the forest, creek, ponds, and meadows below. There are 9 open parking spots situated around the barn for vehicle dwellers to stay and utilize the shared amenities inside the structure, including 2 bathrooms w/ showers, a large communal kitchen, a quiet co-working space with fast wifi, a rec area with gym mats and equipment, ping pong and darts, and laundry. SITE 6 (formally Site 9) is located in the front parking lot of the barn and is situated closest to the barn with access to power. This spot also gets a lot of sun for most of the day.

solar-site-4.desc: The Blue Barn @ Camp Cedar Creek sits on a hill above the creekside campground providing beautiful views of the forest, creek, ponds, and meadows below. There are 9 open parking spots situated around the barn for vehicle dwellers to stay and utilize the shared amenities inside the structure, including 2 bathrooms w/ showers, a large communal kitchen, a quiet co-working space with fast wifi, a rec area with gym mats and equipment, ping pong and darts, and laundry. SITE 4 is situated on the backside of the barn. The best way to park is parallel to the barn. You'll have plenty of room and privacy in this space. The site gets sun in the afternoon, but is shaded by the barn's walls for the first half of the day.

power-site-7.desc: The Blue Barn @ Camp Cedar Creek sits on a hill above the creekside campground providing beautiful views of the forest, creek, ponds, and meadows below. There are 9 open parking spots situated around the barn for vehicle dwellers to stay and utilize the shared amenities inside the structure, including 2 bathrooms w/ showers, a large communal kitchen, a quiet co-working space with fast wifi, a rec area with gym mats and equipment, ping pong and darts, and laundry. SITE 7 (formerly Site 8) is situated between Sites 6 and 8 on the south side of the main parking lot, and has access to power hookups. It also gets plenty of sunshine throughout most of the day.

solar-site-5.desc: The Blue Barn @ Camp Cedar Creek sits on a hill above the creekside campground providing beautiful views of the forest, creek, ponds, and meadows below. There are 9 open parking spots situated around the barn for vehicle dwellers to stay and utilize the shared amenities inside the structure, including 2 bathrooms w/ showers, a large communal kitchen, a quiet co-working space with fast wifi, a rec area with gym mats and equipment, ping pong and darts, and laundry. SITE NO. 5 is located very close to the barn's front entrance, has no direct neighbors and partial views of the creek. This spot gets sunshine all day long so it's great for vehicles with solar panels.
